Mermaid Live Editor for CodeExpander
=====================================

A CodeExpander plugin that embeds the [Mermaid Live Editor](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-live-editor).

- Edit Mermaid diagrams with live preview
- Export diagrams as PNG / SVG
- Support flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, and more

----------

CodeExpander Mermaid 编辑器
===========================

基于 [Mermaid Live Editor](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-live-editor) 的 CodeExpander 插件。

- 实时编辑 Mermaid 图表并预览
- 导出 PNG / SVG 格式
- 支持流程图、时序图、甘特图、类图、状态图、ER 图等多种图表类型
